track.title: Save, load, persistence, and state-boundary archaeology
track.clean_room_rule: No decompiled code, proprietary source, assets, or binaries are reproduced. Ghidra output is evidence, not truth; SDK names and layouts are reference-only provenance.

covered_domains: Cell runtime and Cell resource records
world, planet, star, empire, and space economy state
editor lifecycle, edit history, and asset save boundary
creature, tribe, mission, and progression state
generic Property, PropertyList, ClassSerializer, and resource/database persistence
not_covered: original-process save/load execution or runtime tracing
Ghidra mutation, re-analysis, or save operations
scope.original_runtime_status: No original-process save/load, profile, slot, or editor-runtime oracle exists in the evidence set. The committed Cell runtime record is negative for reaching Cell Stage under tested Wine/input conditions.

evidence_base.details: Static persistence/serialization claims, SDK layouts, PropertyList, ClassSerializer, saved-game header, GameLoadParameters, Cell serializable state, current OpenSpore comparison, and unresolved wire-format questions.
B-K-01 through B-K-11 identify application/mode lifecycle, service roots, Cell state, resource identity, presentation, property/configuration, and shared-state boundaries.
CellGame, cCellSerializableData pointer, mode lifecycle, Cell resource/runtime separation, current OpenSpore projection, and lifecycle state boundaries.
Editor lifecycle, input/message boundaries, animation/model state, UTFWin, and current OpenSpore editor/UI gap.
cEmpire, cStarRecord, cPlanetRecord, cMission, cMissionManager, cSpaceTrading, IDs, versioning, ownership, property relations, and OpenSpore comparison.
SpacePlayerData, cEmpire lazy cache, empire registry, mode/input roots, direct state accessors, map lower-bound mechanics, and contradictory unnamed roots.
Current OpenSpore CellGame, CellSim, entity/player/camera state, fixed-step update, and event recording behavior; not original semantics.
Current mode lifecycle, in-process GameModeManager, and Cell-owned GFX/UI state.
Typed, direct Cell record decoders with fixed type IDs, fixed sizes, variable count layouts, and explicit domain checks.
Current B1 identity-to-record-byte seam, one borrowed DBPF package image, and in-memory provider; not original resource-manager or save-game behavior.

evidence_base.query: read-only function search/decompile/structure queries against SporeApp.exe
evidence_base.details: Direct queries confirmed named accessors, PropertyList read/write, CellGame/GFX/UI roots, cGamePersistenceManager layout, and cGameModeManager layout. No Ghidra writes were requested.

No successful original Cell Stage trace; S5 was recorded negative. No save/load runtime evidence is present.

relationships.statement: The persistence manager is the named orchestration root for saved-game work, while Resource Database/IRecord expose keyed record streams. Exact call path and stream ownership are not observed.
The header's object-count map, game mode, snapshot flag, and current planet key plausibly address saved simulator state and restoration context; no body or trace confirms order.
SDK declarations place .spo game name, star, creature/profile, difficulty, and mode in load parameters. The exact function that consumes each field is not established.
Serializable objects expose Write/Read and related slots; ClassSerializer supplies class attributes and binary/text callbacks. Concrete dispatch is unresolved.

cCellGame at +0x5190 holds an intrusive pointer to cCellSerializableData; CellGame::Initialize initializes the CellGame object and serializable-data path, while CellGame::OnExit/Dispose tears down stage state.

cStarRecord owns vectors of intrusive cPlanetRecord references and carries saved-game versions/timestamp; cPlanetRecord carries PlanetID, species, commodity, civ, tribe, and generated-terrain identities.

cStarManager contains mEmpires keyed by uint32 and mEmpireHomeStarRecords; cEmpire carries mPoliticalID at +0x84. The current-player accessor validates sSpacePlayerData+0x18 against cached cEmpire+0x84 and refreshes via the empire map.

cEmpire owns name, current mode, flags, trait, archetype, enemy/allied vectors, political ID, star/home-planet IDs, UFO/captain ResourceKeys, money, culture, timers, and adventure list; it is serializable by its first vtable slot.
cMission stores owner/target empire and planet references, reward money/tool, unlock tool keys, progress event ID, costs, accept rewards, and an intrusive PropertyList pointer.

cMissionManager has tutorial mission-state map, generator/config PropertyLists, tracked missions, recent mission lists, mission gaps, default icons, and teaching mission vectors. Mission state values are declared but transition ordering is not fully recovered.
cSpaceTrading owns spices, NPC stores, rare map/groups, last NPC store, and newly available commodities. It is not an observed PropertyList owner in the imported layout.

cCreatureGameData stores current brain level, evolution points, learned abilities, and ability mode; cCellSerializableData separately stores Cell progression and evolution-points-spent fields. Their synchronization across stage transitions is not established.

Editor lifecycle and mouse/key handlers route through tools, edit history, animation world, and asset metadata. Editor_Save constructs metadata and submits/saves an asset boundary, but it is not evidence of profile or save-slot persistence.

IConfigManager::Get returns a global config manager; ArgScript and Config/ConfigManager.txt are documented configuration inputs. The config manager body, schema, and migration behavior are not recovered.

Property lookup first searches local entries and falls back to a parent PropertyList; SetProperty updates/inserts by property ID and increments the operation counter. Parent persistence is not established.

cGameModeManager stores mode entries, active index, camera manager, and viewer. SetActiveModeAt exits the current mode when different, updates active state, and enters the selected mode. Live ordering is not observed.

openspore_comparison.summary: OpenSpore has deterministic Cell runtime/content decoding and a narrow resource-byte seam, but no original PropertyList, ClassSerializer, cGamePersistenceManager, save-slot, profile, or .prop/.spo implementation. Current source observations are never treated as original-game evidence.

current_state_boundaries.simulation_reset: CellSim is constructed from an in-memory entity vector and fixed parameters; no checkpoint, save, or load API exists in the current source.
current_state_boundaries.level_transition: Current GameModeManager stores IGameMode pointers in process memory and switches by OnExit/OnEnter; it has no persistence handoff.
current_state_boundaries.editor_operation: Current tree has no editor operation implementation; Cell events and UI rollover state are local and not serialized.
current_state_boundaries.save_load: Current tree has no general save/load implementation, PropertyList codec, ClassSerializer, or .spo reader/writer.
